_schema.note: Keyed by the identifier as it appears in tickers.txt so the scraper matches without renaming. jse_ticker is the code you should actually key any JSE-side join on. confidence: 1.0 = URL seen in a verified source this session; 0.7 = plausible landing page, structure not individually confirmed; 0.0 = not scrapeable, see notes.

fields.jse_ticker: JSE share code, or null if not JSE-listed
fields.primary_exchange: where the primary listing sits - determines which regulator holds the authoritative filings
fields.ir_urls: crawl ENTRY POINTS (landing/index pages). Never terminal PDFs - the harvester needs pages with links on them.
fields.sens_page: company-hosted SENS/regulatory-news page, the best free per-company SENS source
fields.sec_edgar: for SEC registrants: 20-F/6-K filings, free, documented API. Far more reliable than scraping the IR site.
fields.fiscal_year_end_month: month number of financial year end - REQUIRED for any calendar-period join
fields.scrapeable: false means do not point the crawler at this entry
